company.name: Hickory
company.shortDescription: Hickory is a training tool that focuses on retention which helps you hire more people capable of being experts at their position.
company.description:
We're a fast-growing Y-Combinator (S15) backed startup, based in New York.

Hickory is the only training tool focused on retention, turning Sales and Customer Service staff into brand experts. The app predicts when a rep will forget what they’ve learned, and schedules review exercises tailored to their strengths and weaknesses to prevent that from happening.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based learning management system that imports, organizes, and deploys training content via multiple channels to improve employee retention and expertise.
productsAndServices.name: Hickory Training Platform

productsAndServices.description: A tool for creating, importing, and organizing training materials using a card-based editor supporting drag-and-drop of various file types and SCORM imports.
productsAndServices.name: Content Library and Editor

productsAndServices.description: A system that assigns courses to users, triggers reviews based on spaced repetition, and automates notifications and reporting to track learning progress.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Course Assignment and Review System

productsAndServices.description: Services that enable deployment of training content across multiple platforms and integration with existing sign-in systems and communication tools.
productsAndServices.name: Integration and Deployment Services

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,592,175 to $16,540,285, a 6.38x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 31 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 11 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
